title: NSFAS delayed
text: Your allowance has not landed. The group chat is already loud about it.

choices.label: Borrow R50
choices.result: A friend sends it, with a voice note.

title: Load shedding
text: The lights go. Your res is suddenly a dark corridor and a row of phone torches.

choices.label: Study by phone torch
choices.result: You get through half a chapter.

choices.label: Sit outside with everyone
choices.result: Someone has a speaker. Someone has a story.

title: Lecturer surprise test
text: The lecturer smiles in that specific way. Notes closed.

choices.label: Write what you know
choices.result: Not pretty, but you filled the page.

choices.label: Peek once
choices.result: They saw. The whole row went quiet.

title: Derby Day
text: Sunday. Gold or Black. The campus is loud either way.

choices.label: Black
choices.result: Black. Somebody lends you a scarf.
